title: Interview with Hugo
summary: Dana interviewed Hugo, an author, in a research interview.

qa_highlights.question: Tell me about a project that failed.
qa_highlights.answer: A mobile version nobody asked for cost six months and taught them to ask first

qa_highlights.question: Who influenced you the most?
qa_highlights.answer: Their first supervisor, who asked better questions instead of giving answers

qa_highlights.question: What does a normal day look like?
qa_highlights.answer: Starts with the overnight logs, reviews failures, and writes in the afternoon

qa_highlights.question: What was the hardest decision you made?
qa_highlights.answer: Closing the first workshop and keeping the tools

quotes.speaker: Hugo
quotes.text: It cost us six months and taught us to ask first.

quotes.speaker: Hugo
quotes.text: She never gave answers, she only asked better questions.

quotes.speaker: Hugo
quotes.text: We kept the tools and let the lease go.
